svg.title: AD-19 — Preferensi, Reminder, Durable Notification, dan Realtime

g.text: AD-19 — Preferensi, Reminder, Durable Notification, dan Realtime
Muat preference dan data kesehatan aktual
Periksa ownership dan update read state
Simpan perubahan dan hitung unread count
Broadcast event ke private user channel
